faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Ranipet Social Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Social Worker post is 23rd September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Social Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be graduates, preferably with a B.A. in Social Work, Sociology, or Social Sciences from a recognized university. Proficiency in computer skills is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Social Worker position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Social Worker post is 42 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Social Worker role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Social Worker position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,536/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Social Worker post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Social Worker post announced by the District Child Protection Unit Ranipet.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the DCPU Ranipet Social Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Social Worker post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Social Worker post primarily involves Document Verification. Further details might be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the job type for the Social Worker post is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Child Protection Unit Ranipet, which is https://ranipet.nic.in.
